scope: Deterministic preparation and validation of a coordination-only handoff envelope from an evidenced Book workflow to the existing canonical Book content-admission authority. This packet does not execute admission, construct content-admission operations, mutate canonical manuscript state, dispatch providers, retry providers, persist receipts durably, write Prose preferences, publish artifacts or perform blind scoring.
laws: SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK remains the sole canonical manuscript owner and content-object admission remains the sole canonical mutation path.
SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE remains a literary specialist with canonical manuscript-write authority false.
The Book Workflow Orchestrator has coordination authority only and cannot call or emulate commitContentAdmission in this packet.
A handoff may be prepared only from workflow status READY_FOR_ADMISSION_HANDOFF and an exact current source identity.
The exact execution plan must contain one and only one terminal BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF task using BOOK.CANONICAL_MANUSCRIPT_ADMISSION and CANONICAL_MANUSCRIPT_MUTATION.
The admission handoff task must be READY and every required ancestor must be COMPLETED. FAILED, BLOCKED, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, PLANNED, READY or RUNNING required ancestors fail closed.
The Phase-2I evidence chain must validate against the exact current workflow and plan before a handoff can be prepared.

Every required predecessor task must have qualifying evidence in the validated Phase-2I receipt chain. SPECIALIST_SERVICE_TASK requires TASK_RESULT_OBSERVED. AUTHORITY_WAIT requires AUTHOR_DECISION_REFERENCE_OBSERVED. A declared blocked capability can never satisfy an admission predecessor.
Author decisions are explicit references recovered from validated AUTHOR_DECISION_REFERENCE_OBSERVED receipts; the handoff runtime cannot synthesize, infer or impersonate an author decision.
The candidate artifact must be a governed reference emitted as an output_ref by a completed predecessor TASK_RESULT_OBSERVED receipt and must also be present in workflow specialist_output_refs.

Candidate bytes or raw manuscript text never enter the handoff envelope. The candidate digest is a SHA-256 identity that Book admission must independently verify when it constructs and executes its own canonical mutation request.
The handoff binds expected_parent_state_version and expected_parent_state_digest directly to the workflow source identity. A stale Book state invalidates the handoff.
The handoff target is fixed to SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK -> content-object-admission -> commitContentAdmission with required actor class PARENT_SYSTEM. The caller cannot override this target or actor class.
The handoff envelope contains no content-admission operations and no canonical write instruction. It is evidence for Book admission review, not an executable mutation request.
canonical_effect_allowed is always false in the handoff envelope.
A no-change outcome uses COMPLETED_NO_CHANGE and never requires or fabricates a Book admission handoff.
Evidence/provenance receipts remain evidence-only and cannot self-admit a candidate.
Prose, evaluator, Research and Story Bible outputs remain within their declared authority domains and cannot become canonical manuscript state through this handoff.
Fresh-context blind evaluation remains a separate boundary and cannot be manufactured by this packet.
No hosted fixture grants A-01 target, native, private, publication or production authority.
